text:
maya: quick drop 1: compact preview mock for Alerting. aiming for single-line preview under the channel row but seeing a 1-2px jump when expanding in dense mode. figma: https://redwood.design/s/compact-v3.png

ron: reproed. seems badges wrap and change computed height. short fix: set min-height + stable line-height. long fix: force badges to overflow into an ellipsis menu.

leila: keyboard issue: when expanded, focus lands on the last chip. we should focus the preview header on open and implement roving tabindex for chips. add aria-expanded on toggle.

toni: copy inconsistency: "snooze" vs "mute" confusion in support. proposal: use "Snooze" for time-limited pauses, "Mute channel" for channel-wide silence. update tooltips accordingly.

sam: +1. Suggested tooltip text: "Snooze: pause alerts for a set time. Mute channel: stop delivering alerts to this channel until unmuted."

a11y-bot: scan result: snooze pill contrast in dark theme is 3.5:1. target >=4.5:1 for small text. Recommend darken token by ~10% and increase weight to 600.

maya: layout decision: should preview overlay or push the channel list? Overlay keeps list stable; push preserves spatial context. Thoughts?

ron: prefer overlay pinned right with focus trap and Esc to close. avoids layout shift on long lists. animate with 160ms fade + 80ms slide from right. avoid scale.

leila: if overlay: add role="dialog" aria-modal="true", aria-describedby with "Preview for <channel>. Press Esc to close." Also announce via aria-live="polite" when opened.

toni: add quick snooze presets (15m, 1h, 4h, 24h) inline and a "Custom" option. make presets buttons with aria-labels like "Snooze for 15 minutes" for SR users.

sam: telemetry: track preview.open with {variant: overlay|push, mode: compact|expanded, channel_count}. also track preset usage vs custom.

maya: action items: 1) ron: ship CSS min-height + badge overflow (ETA: today). 2) leila: prototype roving tabindex + focus/header announce (ETA: tomorrow). 3) toni: consolidate snooze/mute copy + fix token contrast (ETA: Fri). 4) sam: build overlay dialog with entrance timing + telemetry (ETA: Thu). 5) a11y-bot: re-run scans after changes.

a11y-bot: post-change checklist: axe run, NVDA/VoiceOver check, keyboard-only smoke test, validate aria-live messages are succinct.

maya: thanks all 1: will update figma and ping here when frames are ready :thumbsup:
